The line parallel to $3x - 7y = 65$ has the same slope. Converting the given line to slope-intercept form: $y = \frac{3}{7}x - \frac{65}{7}$, so the slope is $\frac{3}{7}$. Using point-slope form with point $(7,4)$: $y - 4 = \frac{3}{7}(x - 7)$. Substituting $x = 0$ to find $K$:  
$$
y - 4 = \frac{3}{7}(-7) \implies y - 4 = -3 \implies y = 1.
$$  
Thus, $K = 1$.
